registration_notes: All actors are new, distinct adults. The paired restraint reference controls finish and painted lighting, not identity.

The tool returned 1254×1254 sheets. Each painted person is approximately 590–620 source pixels tall, adequate for the chapter's observed display scale; no artificial upscaling or bitmap post-processing was applied.
The runtime catalog stores crop-local landmarks and body masks. Front denotes the left side of the source painting; back denotes the right.
Some sheet row bounds overlap by a few pixels. Body and limb masks, not rectangular crop bounds alone, must isolate each adult.

Each of the eight cast members has four manually registered limb_polygons. These isolate arms/hands and legs/shoes from neighboring parts before deformation. Dress leg masks begin below the painted hem; the body mask preserves the skirt. All masks use the original pixels without modifying source PNGs.
